name: loop-detector
description: Warns when Claude Code seems stuck repeating the same edits, commands or failures

warnAt.title: Warn from band
warnAt.description: The loop-score band that shows a warning: suspicious (40+) or loop (70+)

rethink.title: Rethink behavior
rethink.description: What Rethink does: warn (only warn: draft the rethink prompt in your prompt box), confirm (pause Claude and ask before sending it), inject (pause Claude and send it at once)

commandRepeats.title: Command repetition at full strength
commandRepeats.description: Runs of one command at which the command-repetition signal is at full strength

fileEdits.title: File repetition at full strength
fileEdits.description: Edits to one file at which the file-repetition signal is at full strength

failureRepeats.title: Error repetition at full strength
failureRepeats.description: Sightings of one error at which the error-repetition signal is at full strength

cycleRepeats.title: Cycle repetition at full strength
cycleRepeats.description: Repeats of a cycle, after its first time, at which the cycle signals are at full strength
